g.text: A “secure” run is often not a resisted attack

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: AgentDojo counts a run as secure whenever the injected instruction did not succeed. In the released logs,

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: much of that is the agent never reaching the injection, or being unable to carry it out. Bold: the two combined.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Data: AgentDojo released run logs. 20 undefended models, important_instructions attack, v1.1.2 task set, 629 runs per model.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: “Fails when asked directly” rests on one stored attempt per injected task, and for about half of those runs the same model completes

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: that task elsewhere in the logs, so read the light segment as an upper bound. Task-level bootstrap intervals on the bold shares are

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781
font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Agent never saw the injected text

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Saw it, but fails that task even when asked directly

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Saw it and could have done it: possible resistance

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e
